title: Poincaré duality for pro-étale $\mathbf{Q}_p$-local systems
summary: We prove finiteness and Poincaré duality for pro-étale $\mathbf{Q}_p$-local systems on proper $p$-adic rigid-analytic spaces in the framework of Banach--Colmez spaces and establish their optimal cohomological vanishing bounds. As a consequence, we also obtain ordinary finiteness and duality for their arithmetic pro-étale cohomology. We deduce these results from their analogs for perfect complexes on the Fargues--Fontaine curve, which in turn reduce to Poincaré duality for perfect complexes over period rings.
